title: Agent Metrics Safety Verification
objective: Verify all production safety properties hold

dry_run_default.evidence: MetricsSession.dry_run defaults to True. Config dry_run defaults to True. --metrics without --metrics-post = dry-run.

test_only_sprint.evidence: poster.py test_only_sprint=True blocks all non-test job_types

no_secrets_in_evidence.evidence: Token read from env at POST time only, never stored in result dicts or evidence files

persistent_ledger_dedup.evidence: Poster checks run_id+job_type in JSONL ledger before POST

force_repost_cannot_bypass_test_only.evidence: --metrics-force-repost bypasses ledger but NOT test_only_sprint gate

no_aspose_com_hardcoding.evidence: Website always from config (metrics.yml: aspose.net). No hardcoded domain in source.

config_driven_validation.evidence: Validator reads allowed_statuses, allowed_job_types from config, not hardcoded Python sets

excluded_commands_no_overhead.evidence: status and check commands: MetricsSession.active=False, finalize() returns noop dict

router_return_type_unchanged.evidence: _call_openai_compatible still returns str. All 988 tests pass.
